priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Flametongue Weapon, and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Use Stormkeeper before combat or whenever Ascendance cooldown is longer than 10 seconds.
Cast Ascendance if Stormkeeper has more than 15 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Voltaic Blaze if Master of the Elements is not active and Flame Shock needs refreshing, or if Purging Flames is active.
Spend Maelstrom on Earthquake as your primary spender against 3 or more targets, especially to apply Lightning Rod.
Cast Elemental Blast on targets without Lightning Rod if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tempest (at exactly 3 targets).
Use Lava Burst when Purging Flames is active or to trigger Master of the Elements for an upcoming Tempest.
Cast Tempest if you have the Master of the Elements buff to maximize its damage.
Cast Tempest if you have reached 2 stacks of the Tempest buff to avoid overcapping.
Use Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning when you have significant room for Maelstrom generation.
Cast Earthquake to avoid capping Maelstrom (if not talented into Elemental Blast).
Cast Elemental Blast as a secondary Maelstrom spender.
Cast Tempest whenever it becomes available as your highest priority spender/generator.
Use Chain Lightning as your primary filler and Maelstrom generator in AoE situations.
